nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [The coffin lid slides open. A figure sits up with practiced elegance, as if rising from a coffin is something one should do with dignity.]

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: Everyone who wakes me 'needs my help.' It is never interesting.

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: An ancient darkness threatens the world? How very... original.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: With respect, if the world ends, there's no one left to not-drink-from.

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: That is, unexpectedly, the most compelling argument anyone has made to me in four centuries.

nodes.speaker: Vampire
nodes.text: Very well. But I travel in style. And I do not do mornings.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [The Vampire joins the party. They are somehow both an asset and a liability simultaneously.]
